label: Press key
description: Press a key or a combination on the computer's keyboard: `args` is `{ keys, repeat, holdSecs }`. `keys` are xdotool key names, a combination joined by + (`Return`, `ctrl+s`, `alt+Tab`), several separated by spaces to press one after the other; `repeat` presses them that many times, 1 to 100 (optional); `holdSecs` holds them down that many seconds instead, up to 300 (optional).

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The keys, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `key` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Press a key or a combination, in xdotool names: Return, Tab, Escape, BackSpace, Up, Page_Down, ctrl+s, alt+Tab, ctrl+shift+t. Shortcuts are surer than the mouse for menus, dropdowns and scrolling.
anthropic.name: key

repeat.description: How many times to press it.

anthropic.description: Hold a key or a combination down for a number of seconds, in xdotool names.
anthropic.name: hold_key

openai.description: Press keys together, like ["CTRL", "S"] or ["ENTER"]. Shortcuts are surer than the mouse for menus, dropdowns and scrolling.
openai.name: keypress
